# The simple screen fits your screen {sparkle}
On a smaller display the window was forced wider and taller than the
screen itself, so the right-hand column sat off the edge — "This week"
cut through the middle of its own number — and it could not be dragged
back, because the size it insisted on was larger than the screen had
room for. It now fits whatever screen it is on, and the cards give way
before the window does.

highlights.text: On a smaller display the window was forced wider and taller than the screen itself, so the right-hand column sat off the edge — "This week" cut through the middle of its own number — and it could not be dragged back, because the size it insisted on was larger than the screen had room for. It now fits whatever screen it is on, and the cards give way before the window does.
